goal.en: Talk about what did not happen, what you regret, and what you would prefer — the unreal past.
goal.ar: أن تتحدث عمّا لم يحدث، وعمّا تندم عليه، وعمّا تفضّله — أي الماضي غير الواقعي.

title.ar: wish و if only في الحاضر

text.en: wish + past simple describes a present situation you want to be different: “I wish I had more time.” The past form signals distance from reality, not past time.
text.ar: wish مع الماضي البسيط تصف وضعاً حاضراً تتمنى لو كان غيره: I wish I had more time. وصيغة الماضي هنا تدل على البعد عن الواقع لا على الزمن الماضي.

head: Sentence
Reality
rows: If only it wasn't so far.

text.en: Never use “wish” + will for the present: “I wish I will be rich” is wrong. Say “I wish I were rich.”
text.ar: لا نستخدم wish مع will للحاضر. فجملة I wish I will be rich خطأ، والصواب I wish I were rich.

text.en: “I wish you would…” is different: it complains about someone else's behaviour. “I wish you would listen.”
text.ar: أما I wish you would فمختلفة: تشكو من سلوك شخص آخر، مثل I wish you would listen.

text.en: wish + past perfect regrets something already finished: “I wish I had studied medicine.” One step further back than the present wish.
text.ar: wish مع الماضي التام تعبّر عن ندم على أمر انتهى: I wish I had studied medicine، أي خطوة أبعد في الماضي من التمني الحاضر.

items.en: I wish I hadn't said that.
She wishes she had taken the job.
If only we had left earlier!

text.en: About yourself: would rather + base verb (“I'd rather stay”). About someone else: would rather + past (“I'd rather you stayed”).
text.ar: عن نفسك: would rather مع الفعل المجرد مثل I'd rather stay. وعن غيرك: would rather مع الماضي مثل I'd rather you stayed.

text.en: “It's time” + past simple means it should already be happening: “It's time we left.” (Not “It's time we leave.”)
text.ar: عبارة It's time مع الماضي البسيط تعني أن الأمر كان ينبغي أن يحدث: It's time we left، ولا نقول It's time we leave.

text.en: These past forms never refer to past time. They mark unreality, exactly like the second conditional.
text.ar: صيغ الماضي هنا لا تدل على الزمن الماضي أبداً، بل على عدم الواقعية، تماماً كالشرط الثاني.

text.en: Formal English can drop “if” and invert: Had I known → If I had known. Were she here → If she were here. Should you need help → If you need help.
text.ar: يمكن في الإنجليزية الرسمية حذف if والقلب: Had I known بدل If I had known، وWere she here بدل If she were here، وShould you need help بدل If you need help.

items.en: Had we booked earlier, we would have paid less.
items.ar: لو كنا حجزنا مبكراً لدفعنا أقل.

items.en: Should you have any questions, please contact us.
items.ar: إن كانت لديك أي أسئلة فتواصل معنا.

text.en: This is common in business writing and news. Recognising it matters more than producing it.
text.ar: هذا الأسلوب شائع في المراسلات المهنية والأخبار، والتعرّف عليه أهم من إنتاجه.

questions.sentence: I wish I ___ more free time during the week.
options: had
have
will have
am having

explanation.en: A present wish takes the past simple.
explanation.ar: التمني في الحاضر يأخذ الماضي البسيط.

prompt.en: “I wish I lived in the city centre.” What is true now?
prompt.ar: «I wish I lived in the city centre» ما الواقع الآن؟

options: I do not live in the centre.
I used to live in the centre.
I will move to the centre soon.
I have always lived in the centre.

explanation.en: A wish states the opposite of the present reality.

options: I wish I will speak better English.
I wish I spoke better English than this.
I wish I could speak French as well.
I wish my English was a little better.

explanation.en: “Wish” is never followed by “will” for a present state; use the past simple.
explanation.ar: لا تأتي will بعد wish للتعبير عن حال حاضرة، بل الماضي البسيط.

prompt.en: Which sentence complains about someone else's behaviour?
prompt.ar: أي جملة تشكو من سلوك شخص آخر؟

options: I wish you would answer your phone.
I wish I answered my phone more often.
I wish I had answered the phone then.
I wish my phone worked properly here.

explanation.en: “Wish + would” is aimed at another person's habit, and carries irritation.
explanation.ar: تركيب wish + would يوجَّه إلى عادة شخص آخر ويحمل نبرة تذمّر.

questions.sentence: I wish I ___ that email — it caused a lot of trouble.
options: hadn't sent
didn't send
wouldn't send
haven't sent

explanation.en: Regret about a finished action → wish + past perfect.
explanation.ar: الندم على فعل انتهى يقتضي wish مع الماضي التام.

prompt.en: Which sentence regrets something that already happened?
prompt.ar: أي جملة تندم على أمر وقع فعلاً؟

options: I wish I had accepted their offer.
I wish I accepted more invitations.
I wish they would make me an offer.
I wish their offer was more generous.

explanation.en: Past perfect after “wish” points at a finished event; the others describe the present.
explanation.ar: الماضي التام بعد wish يشير إلى حدث منتهٍ، أما البقية فتصف الحاضر.

prompt.en: Express regret: “I didn't book the tickets early.” → “I wish I ___ the tickets early.”
prompt.ar: عبّر عن الندم: I didn't book the tickets early ← I wish I ___ the tickets early.

explanation.en: wish + past perfect converts a past fact into a regret.
explanation.ar: wish مع الماضي التام تحوّل الحقيقة الماضية إلى ندم.

questions.answer: If only we had left an hour earlier

explanation.en: “If only” works like “wish” but is more emphatic.
explanation.ar: تعمل If only عمل wish لكنها أشد توكيداً.

questions.sentence: I'd rather you ___ anything to her about this.
options: didn't say
don't say
won't say
not saying

explanation.en: “Would rather” about ANOTHER person takes the past simple.
explanation.ar: would rather حين تتعلق بشخص آخر تأخذ الماضي البسيط.

options: I'd rather to stay at home tonight.
I'd rather stay at home this evening.
I'd rather you stayed at home tonight.
I would rather not discuss it now.

explanation.en: No “to” after “would rather” when the subject is the same.
explanation.ar: لا نضع to بعد would rather حين يكون الفاعل واحداً.

questions.sentence: It's time we ___ about the budget seriously.
options: talked
talk
will talk
are talking

explanation.en: “It's time” + past simple means it is already overdue.
explanation.ar: It's time مع الماضي البسيط تعني أن الوقت قد تأخر فعلاً.

prompt.en: Match the structure with its meaning.

explanation.en: All four use unreal forms, but each points at a different person or time.
explanation.ar: الأربعة تستخدم صيغاً غير واقعية، لكن كلاً منها يشير إلى شخص أو زمن مختلف.

prompt.en: Rewrite without “if”: “If I had known, I would have called.”
prompt.ar: أعد الصياغة بحذف if: If I had known, I would have called.

options: Had I known, I would have called.
Did I know, I would have called.
Have I known, I would have called.
Was I known, I would have called.

explanation.en: Drop “if” and move “had” in front of the subject.
explanation.ar: نحذف if ونقدّم had على الفاعل.

prompt.en: Which sentence fits a formal customer email?
prompt.ar: أي جملة تناسب بريداً رسمياً للعملاء؟

options: Should you require further assistance, please contact us.
If you want more help then just write to us again.
You need more help? Contact us whenever you like.
Want help again? Just send us another message.

explanation.en: “Should you require …” is the standard formal conditional in business writing.
explanation.ar: صيغة Should you require هي الشرط الرسمي المعتاد في المراسلات المهنية.

prompt.en: “Had the report been ready, the decision would have been easier.” What happened?
prompt.ar: ماذا حدث في الواقع بحسب هذه الجملة؟

options: The report was not ready, so the decision was hard.
The report was ready and the decision was easy.
The report will be ready before the decision.
The decision was taken before the report existed.

explanation.en: An inverted third conditional states the opposite of what really happened.
explanation.ar: الشرط الثالث بصيغة القلب يفيد أن الواقع كان خلاف ذلك.
